functions.name: Observations
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(Y, [Filter],
  LET(
    filt_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Filter), TRUE, Filter),
    ROWS(FILTER(Y, filt_arg))
  ))

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: n — count of rows used in the regression as a scalar integer
functions.description:
n (number of observations) is the count of data points available to the model after any filtering is applied. It is the fundamental sample size that drives all degrees-of-freedom calculations.

Returns ROWS(FILTER(Y, filt_arg)). X_s is not required because row count is fully determined by Y.

functions.name: DF_Regression

arguments.name: X_s
arguments.description: column range of predictors (single or multi-column)

functions.yields: df_regression (k, number of predictors) as a scalar integer
functions.description:
df_regression is the number of degrees of freedom attributable to the regression model — equal to k, the number of predictor columns. The intercept term (if any) is not counted here; it is accounted for implicitly in df_total.

Returns COLUMNS(X_s). Filter and Allow_Intercept do not affect this value.

functions.name: DF_Total
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    n,         Observations(Y, filt_arg),
    IF(allow_arg, n - 1, n)
  ))

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: df_total (n-1 with intercept, n without) as a scalar integer
functions.description:
df_total is the total degrees of freedom for the sum of squares. When an intercept is fit (default), one df is spent estimating the grand mean, giving n - 1. When the model is forced through the origin (Allow_Intercept = FALSE), no df is spent on the mean, giving n. df_total partitions into df_regression + df_residual.

Calls Observations() for n, then returns IF(allow_arg, n-1, n).

functions.name: R_squared
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(X_s, Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    INDEX(LINEST(FILTER(Y, filt_arg), FILTER(X_s, filt_arg), allow_arg, TRUE), 3, 1)
  ))

arguments.name: X_s
arguments.description: column range of predictors (single or multi-column)

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: R² (coefficient of determination) as a scalar in [0, 1]
functions.description:
R² (coefficient of determination) is the proportion of variance in Y explained by the regression model. It equals SS_regression / SS_total, ranges from 0 (no explanatory power) to 1 (perfect fit), and is the square of Multiple R.

Returns INDEX(LINEST(...), 3, 1) directly. R_squared is the base statistic from which Multiple_R and Adjusted_R2 are derived.

functions.name: DF_Residual
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(X_s, Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    DF_Total(Y, allow_arg, filt_arg) - DF_Regression(X_s)
  ))

arguments.name: X_s
arguments.description: column range of predictors (single or multi-column)

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: df_residual (n-k-1 with intercept, n-k without) as a scalar integer
functions.description:
df_residual (also called df_error) is the degrees of freedom remaining after the regression model has been fit. With an intercept it equals n - k - 1; without an intercept it equals n - k. It is the denominator degrees of freedom for the F-test and the penalty term in Adjusted R².

Computed as DF_Total(...) - DF_Regression(...), inheriting the Allow_Intercept correction from DF_Total.

functions.name: Multiple_R
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(X_s, Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    SQRT(R_squared(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg))
  ))

arguments.name: X_s
arguments.description: column range of predictors (single or multi-column)

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: Multiple R (correlation coefficient) as a scalar in [0, 1]
functions.description:
Multiple R is the Pearson correlation between the observed values of Y and the values predicted by the regression model. It ranges from 0 (no linear relationship) to 1 (perfect linear fit) and is the square root of R².

Computed as SQRT(R_squared(...)).

functions.name: Adjusted_R2
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(X_s, Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    1 - (1 - R_squared(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg))
      * DF_Total(Y, allow_arg, filt_arg)
      / DF_Residual(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg)
  ))

arguments.name: X_s
arguments.description: column range of predictors (single or multi-column)

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: Adjusted R² as a scalar, typically in [0, 1] but can be negative
functions.description:
Adjusted R² penalises R² for the number of predictors relative to sample size, correcting for the inflation that occurs when irrelevant predictors are added. It equals 1 - (1 - R²) × df_total / df_residual, which reduces to the familiar 1 - (1 - R²)(n-1)/(n-k-1) when an intercept is fit. Unlike R² it can decrease when a predictor adds less explanatory power than expected by chance, and can be negative when the model fits worse than a horizontal line.

Computed as 1 - (1 - R_squared(...)) * DF_Total(...) / DF_Residual(...), inheriting the Allow_Intercept correction from both df functions.

functions.name: SS_Total
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    y_filt, FILTER(Y, filt_arg),
    IF(allow_arg, DEVSQ(y_filt), SUMSQ(y_filt))
  ))

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: SS_total (total sum of squares) as a scalar
functions.description:
SS_total is the total variation in Y before any predictors are added. With an intercept it equals the sum of squared deviations from the mean — DEVSQ(Y). Without an intercept it equals the raw sum of squares — SUMSQ(Y). It is the denominator in the R² formula and partitions into SS_regression + SS_residual.

Returns DEVSQ(filtered_Y) when Allow_Intercept is TRUE, SUMSQ(filtered_Y) when FALSE. Does not require X_s.

functions.name: SS_Residual
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(X_s, Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    SS_Total(Y, allow_arg, filt_arg) * (1 - R_squared(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg))
  ))

arguments.name: X_s
arguments.description: column range of predictors (single or multi-column)

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: SS_residual (residual/error sum of squares) as a scalar
functions.description:
SS_residual (also called SS_error) is the variation in Y left unexplained by the regression model — the sum of squared differences between observed and fitted values. It equals SS_total × (1 - R²) and shrinks as the model improves.

Computed as SS_Total(...) * (1 - R_squared(...)).

functions.name: SS_Regression
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(X_s, Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    SS_Total(Y, allow_arg, filt_arg) * R_squared(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg)
  ))

arguments.name: X_s
arguments.description: column range of predictors (single or multi-column)

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: SS_regression (explained/model sum of squares) as a scalar
functions.description:
SS_regression (also called SS_model or SS_explained) is the variation in Y explained by the regression model — the reduction in total variation achieved by adding the predictors. It equals SS_total × R² and grows as the model explains more.

Computed as SS_Total(...) * R_squared(...).

functions.name: SE_Regression
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(X_s, Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    SQRT(SS_Residual(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg) / DF_Residual(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg))
  ))

arguments.name: X_s
arguments.description: column range of predictors (single or multi-column)

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: SE_regression (standard error of the regression) as a scalar
functions.description:
SE_regression (also called the root mean square error or S) measures the typical distance between observed Y values and the regression line, in the same units as Y. It equals √(SS_residual / df_residual) = √MSE. Smaller values indicate a tighter fit.

Computed as SQRT(SS_Residual(...) / DF_Residual(...)).

functions.name: Coefficients
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(X_s, Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    ls,        LINEST(FILTER(Y, filt_arg), FILTER(X_s, filt_arg), allow_arg, FALSE),
    k,         COLUMNS(X_s),
    TRANSPOSE(IF(allow_arg,
      HSTACK(INDEX(ls, 1, k + 1), CHOOSECOLS(ls, SEQUENCE(1, k, k, -1))),
      CHOOSECOLS(ls, SEQUENCE(1, k, k, -1))
    ))
  ))

arguments.name: X_s
arguments.description: column range of predictors (single or multi-column)

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: vertical array of fitted OLS coefficients — intercept first (when included), then predictors in input order
functions.description:
Returns a vertical spill array of the fitted OLS regression coefficients. When Allow_Intercept is TRUE the intercept is the first element, followed by the coefficients for each column of X_s in input order. When Allow_Intercept is FALSE the output contains only the k predictor coefficients.

Uses LINEST with stats=FALSE (row 1 only), then reverses and optionally prepends the intercept to match X_s column order.

functions.name: SE_Coefficients
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(X_s, Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    ls,        LINEST(FILTER(Y, filt_arg), FILTER(X_s, filt_arg), allow_arg, TRUE),
    ses,       INDEX(ls, 2),
    k,         COLUMNS(X_s),
    TRANSPOSE(IF(allow_arg,
      HSTACK(INDEX(ses, 1, k + 1), CHOOSECOLS(ses, SEQUENCE(1, k, k, -1))),
      CHOOSECOLS(ses, SEQUENCE(1, k, k, -1))
    ))
  ))

arguments.name: X_s
arguments.description: column range of predictors (single or multi-column)

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: vertical array of standard errors of the OLS coefficients — same order as Coefficients
functions.description:
Returns a vertical spill array of the standard errors of the fitted OLS coefficients, in the same order as Coefficients (intercept first when included).

Uses LINEST with stats=TRUE and extracts row 2 (the standard error row), then applies the same reversal as Coefficients.

functions.name: T_Stats
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(X_s, Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    Coefficients(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg) / SE_Coefficients(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg)
  ))

arguments.name: X_s
arguments.description: column range of predictors (single or multi-column)

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: vertical array of t-statistics for each coefficient (coefficient / standard error)
functions.description:
Returns a vertical spill array of t-statistics for each OLS coefficient. Each element equals the corresponding Coefficients value divided by its SE_Coefficients value.

Computed as Coefficients(...) / SE_Coefficients(...).

functions.name: P_Values
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(X_s, Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    T.DIST.2T(ABS(T_Stats(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg)), DF_Residual(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg))
  ))

arguments.name: X_s
arguments.description: column range of predictors (single or multi-column)

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: vertical array of two-tailed p-values for each coefficient
functions.description:
Returns a vertical spill array of two-tailed p-values for each OLS coefficient, testing the null hypothesis that the true coefficient equals zero.

Computed as T.DIST.2T(ABS(T_Stats(...)), DF_Residual(...)).

functions.name: CI_Lower
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(X_s, Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter], [N],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    n_arg,     IF(ISOMITTED(N),               95,   N),
    alpha_arg, (100 - n_arg) / 100,
    Coefficients(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg)
      - T.INV.2T(alpha_arg, DF_Residual(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg))
        * SE_Coefficients(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg)
  ))

arguments.name: X_s
arguments.description: column range of predictors (single or multi-column)

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: vertical array of lower confidence interval bounds for each coefficient
functions.description:
Returns a vertical spill array of the lower bounds of the confidence intervals for each OLS coefficient. Uses a two-tailed t critical value at the specified confidence level.

Computed as Coefficients(...) - T.INV.2T((100-N)/100, DF_Residual(...)) * SE_Coefficients(...).

functions.name: CI_Upper
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(X_s, Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter], [N],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    n_arg,     IF(ISOMITTED(N),               95,   N),
    alpha_arg, (100 - n_arg) / 100,
    Coefficients(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg)
      + T.INV.2T(alpha_arg, DF_Residual(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg))
        * SE_Coefficients(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg)
  ))

arguments.name: X_s
arguments.description: column range of predictors (single or multi-column)

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: vertical array of upper confidence interval bounds for each coefficient
functions.description:
Returns a vertical spill array of the upper bounds of the confidence intervals for each OLS coefficient. Uses a two-tailed t critical value at the specified confidence level.

Computed as Coefficients(...) + T.INV.2T((100-N)/100, DF_Residual(...)) * SE_Coefficients(...).

functions.name: CI_Excludes_Zero
functions.formula_display:
=LAMBDA(X_s, Y, [Allow_Intercept], [Filter], [N],
  LET(
    allow_arg, IF(ISOMITTED(Allow_Intercept), TRUE, Allow_Intercept),
    filt_arg,  IF(ISOMITTED(Filter),          TRUE, Filter),
    n_arg,     IF(ISOMITTED(N),               95,   N),
    alpha_arg, (100 - n_arg) / 100,
    (CI_Lower(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg, n_arg) > 0)
      + (CI_Upper(X_s, Y, allow_arg, filt_arg, n_arg) < 0) > 0
  ))

arguments.name: X_s
arguments.description: column range of predictors (single or multi-column)

arguments.name: Filter
arguments.description: boolean array — TRUE includes the row, FALSE excludes it

functions.yields: vertical array of booleans — TRUE when the confidence interval for that coefficient does not straddle zero
functions.description:
Returns a vertical spill array of booleans indicating whether each coefficient's confidence interval excludes zero, i.e. whether the coefficient is statistically distinguishable from zero at the given confidence level.

TRUE when CI_Lower > 0 (entirely positive) or CI_Upper < 0 (entirely negative). Computed as (CI_Lower(...) > 0) + (CI_Upper(...) < 0) > 0.
